headline: Winless Malaga visit Alaves, and the hosts are still favoured
summary: Malaga are bottom of La Liga: 20th, with 4 points and no win this season. Last Sunday they lost 5-2 at home to Real Sociedad, and the deeper problem is creation — 0.70 expected goals per game. Cadena SER reports Joaquin Munoz is expected to miss Friday with a muscle injury. Alaves are 7th on 11 points, yet they have lost 4 of their last 5, so favouritism is not built on form. Across 10 bookmakers, margin removed, Alaves are 54.9% favourites, rated about three-quarters of a goal better. The main goals line is 2.25, with Over at 53.1%.
read: Malaga arrive bottom of La Liga, winless in nine and beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad last weekend, while Alaves have lost four of their last five. The market still makes Alaves clear favourites at 54.9%, rated about 0.7 goals the better team, with a goal line just above two and a quarter.

facts.fact: Malaga are bottom of La Liga with four points from nine games and are still without a win this season.
facts.meaning: They arrive at Mendizorroza as the division's 20th-placed side, five points adrift of the team directly above them.

facts.fact: Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They conceded five at their own ground four days before this trip, the heaviest scoreline in their recent run.

facts.fact: Malaga have averaged 0.70 expected goals per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They are creating very little: only once in that run did they pass one expected goal.

facts.fact: Alaves have lost four of their last five La Liga games, a run of one draw and four defeats.
facts.meaning: The home side's own form is poor — they have taken one point from fifteen — so favouritism here is not built on a hot streak.

facts.fact: Alaves sit seventh in La Liga on 11 points after nine matches.
facts.meaning: Their early-season points haul has them in the top half despite the current losing run — a home win keeps them there.

facts.fact: Cadena SER reported nine hours ago that Malaga's Joaquin Munoz has a right soleus muscle injury and is expected to miss Friday's game at Alaves.
facts.meaning: Another midfield absence for the division's bottom side, on top of the doubts already on their list.

facts.fact: Malaga's J. Cruz is listed as doubtful with a muscle injury after 251 minutes across seven appearances this season.
facts.meaning: He is a rotation midfielder rather than an automatic starter, so his absence would trim options rather than reshape the eleven.

facts.fact: Alaves are rated 54.9% to win, with the draw at 25.7% and Malaga at 19.4%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that the home side takes the points — but well short of a one-sided price.

sources.fact: Alaves lost 2-1 away to Celta Vigo in La Liga, a result that lifted Celta to eighth in the table.
Alaves are due to face Barcelona at home in La Liga on October 31.
Alaves players not selected for other squads could be called up by the Basque Country national team for their November friendly at San Mames.
Cadena SER reports that Malaga's Joaquin Munoz has a right soleus muscle injury and is expected to miss Friday's La Liga clash against Alaves.
Malaga were beaten 5-2 at home by Real Sociedad in La Liga on October 18.
Takefusa Kubo scored a goal and added an assist against Malaga on his first start since September.
The match is La Liga's tenth round fixture, with Malaga visiting Vitoria to face Alaves at Mendizorroza.
